steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Create the basic HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript files for the calculator application.

steps.title: Configure Tailwind CSS
steps.description: Add the Tailwind CSS CDN to index.html for utility-first styling.

steps.title: Create Basic Calculator Layout
steps.description: Design the main container for the calculator with a display and a keypad using Tailwind CSS.

steps.title: Implement Calculator Display
steps.description: Add an input field for displaying numbers and results, styled with Tailwind CSS.

steps.title: Add Number Buttons (0-9)
steps.description: Create buttons for digits 0 through 9, applying Tailwind CSS for styling.

steps.title: Add Operator Buttons (+, -, *, /)
steps.description: Create buttons for basic arithmetic operations, styled distinctly with Tailwind CSS.

steps.title: Add Special Function Buttons (C, =)
steps.description: Include buttons for clearing the input and calculating the result, with appropriate styling.

steps.title: Add Decimal Point Button
steps.description: Include a button for the decimal point to allow floating-point number input.

steps.title: Implement Basic Calculator Logic
steps.description: Write JavaScript to handle number and operator button clicks, updating the display.

steps.title: Implement Arithmetic Operations
steps.description: Develop JavaScript functions for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

steps.title: Handle 'Equals' Functionality
steps.description: Implement the logic for the '=' button to perform the calculation and display the final result.

steps.title: Implement 'Clear' Functionality
steps.description: Add JavaScript to reset the calculator state and clear the display when 'C' is pressed.

steps.title: Add Decimal Point Logic
steps.description: Ensure the decimal point can only be added once per number in the display.

steps.title: Handle Division by Zero Error
steps.description: Add logic to prevent division by zero and display an appropriate error message.

steps.title: Refine UI Responsiveness
steps.description: Adjust layout and button sizing to ensure the calculator looks good on various screen sizes.

steps.title: Add Keyboard Support (Optional)
steps.description: Implement keyboard event listeners to allow input via keyboard.

steps.title: Final Review and Polish
steps.description: Perform a comprehensive review of the design, functionality, and code quality across all files.

steps.title: Building calculatorapp
steps.description: The calculator web application is now complete and ready for use.
